entities.summary: Yunus Özyavuz, better known by his stage name Sagopa Kajmer or formerly known as DJ Mic Check and Silahsız Kuvvet, is a Turkish rapper, singer, songwriter, record producer, and DJ. He is the first and only rapper to have given concerts in all of 81 provinces of Turkey.
